in_marathi.name: Saaransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saaransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saaransh means 'achiever, victor'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saaras', which means 'thread' or 'line'. The name Saaransh signifies one who follows the righteous path and achieves his goals through wisdom and intelligence.
